items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What about Tommy Dorsey and what was your impression of Tommy Dorsey and Glenn Miller? Did you think much of them? [INTERVIEWEE] I don't know nothing about (vulgarizations?) but they both are very nice guys. [INTERVIEWEE] I think it's good. I know Tommy's good.

ctx.x: Switched mouthpieces and horns - oh no, kept the mouthpieces and switched horns.
Tell me, after 1950 you had mentioned that you had worked with Red Allen - the band with Red Allen during the 40's - and up until 1950 you all worked together. Did you all stay together after 1950?
